text:
morgan (oncall): getting alerts — p99 for /v1/generate spiking to ~3.2s for several tenants :rotating_light:
morgan (oncall): baseline p99 is ~950ms, started at 14:42 UTC
lia (support): customers reporting UI timeouts, escalations in #support-escalations
carmen (eng-sre): noted a recent canary deploy 13:58 UTC to runtime-1, could be related
raj (runtime): pulling traces now, but quick mitigation: enable circuit-breaker/throttles on heavy seq lengths and fallback to smaller model
kai (product): we should avoid full rollback if possible — prefer graded fallbacks so critical flows still work
raj (runtime): agree. plan: 1) enable circuit-breaker for requests with seq_len>4096 and chunked requests, 2) route 20% traffic to quantized-7b fallback model, 3) temporarily tighten per-key rate limits for suspicious pods
morgan (oncall): can we hit those fast? give commands pls
carmen (eng-sre): runbook snippet to flip circuit-breaker via admin api:
```bash
# enable circuit breaker for long seqs
curl -X POST https://admin.redwood.internal/v1/guardrails/circuit-breakers \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"match":{"route":"/v1/generate","predicates":{"seq_len":
    {">":4096}}},"action":{"type":"reject","status":429,"reason":"seq_too_long_guardrail"}}'
```
raj (runtime): and to add fallback routing policy:
```bash
# route 20% to fallback-model in routing policy
curl -X POST https://admin.redwood.internal/v1/routing/policies \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","policy":{"type":"weighted","buckets":[{"model":"prod/redwood-13b","weight":80},{"model":"prod/redwood-7b-q4","weight":20}]}}'
```
lia (support): will notify the top-5 affected customers that we have mitigation in progress
morgan (oncall): rolling now: enabling seq_len circuit-breaker -> will post result
[carmen reaction: :white_check_mark:]
carmen (eng-sre): circuit-breaker enabled, status 200, ruleset id cb-2210004321
raj (runtime): applying routing policy now
raj (runtime): routing change applied, traffic split shows ~18-22% to 7b fallback (expected jitter)
morgan (oncall): p99 dropping to ~1.2s within 3 minutes :tada:
kai (product): nice. need follow-ups: add automatic SLO guardrail to trigger this policy at p99>1.5s for 5m window
carmen (eng-sre): proposed guardrail config (to be added to console):
```json
{"slo_trigger":{"metric":"p99_latency","threshold_ms":1500,"window_minutes":5,"actions":[{"type":"apply_routing_policy","policy":"fallback_20pct"},{"type":"throttle_keys","percent":25}]}}
```
raj (runtime): we should also add a circuit-breaker that rejects oversized requests earlier in the proxy to save GPU cycles
morgan (oncall): agree. also enabling temporary global per-key rate limit bumpdown from 100rps->40rps for heavy tenants (via quota service)
[carmen reaction: :eyes:]
lia (support): logged customer notifications and ticket IDs in the incident doc: https://intranet/r/inc-2210004321
kai (product): action items: 1) add automated guardrail rule in Console (priority P0), 2) add unit tests for routing policy rollback, 3) review oncall playbook wording
carmen (eng-sre): owners: raj -> runtime mitigations + kernel revert plan if needed, morgan -> oncall coordination + customer comms, kai -> product guardrail design, lia -> customer updates
raj (runtime): will instrument a quick metric to track fallback model quality delta for these tenants (send eval hooks)
morgan (oncall): monitoring: rcli metrics tail --env prod --route /v1/generate --window 5m --agg p99,p95 --format short
morgan (oncall): command output shows p99 -> 1.2s, p95 -> 450ms
lia (support): customers responding — latency improved for majority, 2 customers still seeing intermittent errors, escalating to eng-sev
carmen (eng-sre): for follow-up: schedule a short postmortem, add a guardrail test into CI to simulate bursty seq_len traffic, and add an automatic rollback if p99>2.5s after deploy for >10m
kai (product): also document fallback-model labeling in Console so customers understand degraded mode vs full rollback
raj (runtime): if we see sustained improvement we'll keep fallback policy for 1h then gradually revert to baseline over 30min window
morgan (oncall): last check: p99 stable ~980ms, closing active mitigation. I'll leave the circuit-breaker active for 1hr per runbook
[carmen reaction: :white_check_mark:]
lia (support): closing loop with customers, will update tickets with mitigation timeline
morgan (oncall): thanks team — filing follow-up tasks in backlog: RD-guardrails-2210, runtime-eval-2210
